title: Crop Protection / IPM guidance for rice planthopper management
evidence_notes: TNAU rice IPM guidance recommends conserving Cyrtorhinus lividipennis as a natural enemy in brown planthopper management. TNAU IPM guidance also recommends sparing natural-enemy defenders during field sprays and avoiding broad-spectrum pesticides.
limitations: The guidance concerns management of rice planthoppers and conservation of their natural enemies. It does not establish a chemical treatment for killing Cyrtorhinus lividipennis.
notes: Used to verify conservation/cultural management and chemical-management precautions for the beneficial Mirid natural enemy.
